_note: Quotations marked and cited in the text (BUG-632). Wording shared only inside such a quotation does not confirm an originality match: quoting a source with its citation is the honest way to use it. A quotation counts only when a citation sits beside it, because most quotation marks in a thesis are not quotations (button labels, section titles, code). Symmetric marks (") are paired by orientation: an opening mark follows a space or bracket and precedes a word; a closing mark follows a word. Single quotation marks are not listed: they cannot be told apart from apostrophes. after_words / before_words: how many words may separate the quotation from the start of a citation after it, or from the end of a citation before it. Patterns are Python regular expressions.
